The primary objective of this plan is to transform today's Client flow into long-term retirement income, tax efficiency, family protection, and legacy value.
Every recommendation throughout this plan has been designed to support one or more of the following objectives.
Protect income, family, and future plans
Maintain access to capital for future opportunities

The opportunity is not simply to accumulate assets.
The opportunity is to create a coordinated structure that supports every major financial goal simultaneously.

This approach creates greater flexibility, tax efficiency, and stability throughout retirement.

Why Your Monthly Savings Doesn't Equal Retirement Contributions
Not every dollar of monthly savings is allocated toward retirement.

Some funds have already been designated toward goals discussed during your planning process, including debt reduction, education planning, emergency reserves, estate planning, insurance implementation, and other personal priorities.
As additional planning areas are implemented, these allocations will be incorporated into your complete Financial Life Plan™.
Government benefits provide the foundation of your retirement income strategy.
While these benefits are unlikely to fund retirement on their own, they provide predictable income that complements
your personal and corporate retirement strategies.
The TFSA remains one of the most flexible investment vehicles available to Canadian families.
Growth within the account occurs tax-free and withdrawals can be accessed without triggering additional tax. This offers additional retirement flexibility and emergency access to capital if required.
Your RRSP accounts are currently being used as a temporary retirement savings vehicle while your Personal Pension Plan (PPP) is being established.

Once the Personal Pension Plan has been finalized, the assets accumulated within your RRSPs are expected to be transferred into the PPP, allowing them to become part of your long-term retirement income strategy.
As a result, the retirement income projections shown throughout this plan are based primarily on the Personal Pension Plan.
The Personal Pension Plan is designed to create predictable retirement income while improving long-term tax efficiency.
Unlike traditional retirement savings strategies, the PPP is structured specifically to help transform today's savings into a reliable future income stream.

The Corporate Liquid Bucket is designed to provide flexibility, liquidity, and continued compound growth within your overall financial plan.
Unlike retirement assets that may be restricted or dedicated to a specific purpose, this bucket remains accessible and adaptable throughout your lifetime.

This bucket is designed to provide flexibility today while remaining an important source of retirement income tomorrow. Funds can be accessed when needed, while still benefiting from long-term compound growth.

The Corporate Fixed Bucket is designed to convert taxable corporate dollars into tax-efficient and ultimately tax-free retirement income and is the only strategy that cannot be pursued without medical underwriting.
For many incorporated professionals, this becomes one of the most impactful components of their overall financial strategy.
This is the only strategy within your Retirement Buckets framework that requires medical underwriting before it can be implemented.
Over the next two to three months, we will complete the steps required to give this strategy the highest probability of approval.
Once the insurance application is completed, a nurse will contact you to schedule a medical examination.

After the first two steps are complete, our team will work directly with the underwriter to pursue the most favourable outcome possible. During this process, the insurer may request additional documents or signed forms.
This process can take time, but our team will manage the underwriting process closely and keep you updated as we move toward a final decision.
Your main responsibility is to complete the application and medical examination, and to provide any additional information requested by the insurer.
Once those first steps are complete, RFL will coordinate the remaining process on your behalf.
One of the unique advantages of the Corporate Fixed Bucket is the ability to access capital while allowing the strategy to continue working in the background.
Over time, the strategy creates collateral value that may be used to support future opportunities without requiring you to dismantle your long-term plan.
The purpose of your Retirement Buckets strategy is to create multiple streams of income that work together to support your lifestyle throughout retirement.

Why RESP Alone May Not Be Enough
When planning for a child's future education, our objective is to ensure sufficient funding is available to cover all four years of post-secondary studies.
The RESP remains a foundational tool, but it will not always be sufficient to fully fund future education costs on its own.
Based on our projections, there will be a funding gap between the estimated cost of education and the amount expected to be available through traditional education savings strategies.
As a result, an additional funding strategy must be implemented to help ensure
education goals can be achieved without impacting your retirement or other long-term financial objectives.
Creating Additional Flexibility For Future Education Funding
As discussed earlier, RESP accounts may not always be sufficient to fully fund future education costs on their own.
The Education Insurance Wrapper is designed to complement your existing education strategy by creating an additional source of tax-efficient capital that can be accessed when needed.

Similar to the Corporate Fixed Bucket, this strategy utilizes a permanent insurance structure. However, because it is intended to support children under the age of 18, it must be owned personally rather than corporately.

A successful financial plan protects not only your assets, but also your ability to continue building wealth.
The purpose of this section is to review the protection strategies designed to support your family, income, and long-term goals should an unexpected event occur.
Many financial plans focus exclusively on accumulation.
A comprehensive financial plan also addresses the risks that could interrupt the journey toward a Rich, Fulfilling Life.
Term Life Insurance is designed to protect your family's financial future during the years when they are most dependent on your income and savings capacity.
The purpose of this coverage is to help ensure that your family's lifestyle, education goals, and long-term financial plans can continue uninterrupted in the event of a premature death.
A tax-free lump sum benefit would be paid directly to your beneficiaries, providing financial security during a difficult period and helping preserve the strategies outlined throughout this plan.
This coverage is intended to help:
educe financial strain during an unexpected event
Maintain flexibility and financial independence for your surviving family members

A successful financial plan is built not only to create wealth, but also to protect it. Term Life Insurance helps ensure that the goals outlined throughout this plan remain achievable, even if life does not unfold as expected.
A serious illness can create both emotional and financial stress.
Critical Illness Insurance is designed to provide a tax-free lump sum payment that can be used however you choose following the diagnosis of a covered condition.
Coverage recommendations have been developed based on your current income, savings capacity, and long-term objectives.
Final coverage amounts will be confirmed during implementation.
The goal is to ensure that a health event does not force you to compromise the retirement, education, or legacy goals outlined throughout this plan.
Your ability to earn an income remains one of your most valuable financial assets.
Disability Insurance is designed to replace a portion of your income if an illness or injury prevents you from working.
Protecting your income helps ensure that your financial plan can continue moving forward even when life does not go according to plan.
